text:
julia: booking update for our SF workshop. A few oddities: 1) Event vendor sent one invoice for the room block + catering but travel agent charged the hotel on corporate card for rooms later. How do I submit the single vendor invoice? 2) We bought a box of branded swag on my personal card (45 shirts). Reimbursable? 3) I paid for parking at the venue on cash because the pay station was weird  lost the printed ticket. 4) Are local SIM cards reimbursable? 5) Do we need preapproval to buy day-of rental-car insurance?

liz (People Ops): Short answers: 1) split the vendor invoice into two expense lines in Expensify: one line for the vendor/catering total (attach invoice) and mark which portion was charged to corporate card via travel agent (attach the agent receipt). Request reimbursement only for the personal-card portion. 2) Swag bought for an official event is reimbursable if pre-approved by Events/Product. Attach invoice and note quantities; unit cost unreasonable will be questioned. 3) For lost parking tickets under $25 we accept a short note + an affidavit + card charge or cash receipt photo; if no receipt, get manager approval. 4) Local SIM cards and reasonable data plans for work travel are reimbursable. If you use it for personal heavy streaming, finance may flag. 5) Rental-car insurance: company policy prefers employees decline CDW if covered by corporate card or company policy; if you need day-of insurance, get manager pre-approval and put a note.

julia: vendor invoice is a single PDF with line items. travel agent shows a separate corporate charge on their portal. i'll split and attach both. for swag, i have a purchase order email from Events. good?

anne (Events): PO email is perfect  attach it. Also include the attendee list if shirts are attendee swag. If they are promo-only, mark as marketing budget and route to Marketing for approval.

josh (Finance): For the split invoice: do this flow when creating expenses:
```
- Expense 1: Vendor invoice - Catering portion - total X - mark as reimbursable - attach invoice + mapping note.
- Expense 2: Vendor invoice - Room block charged to corporate via travel agent - mark as charged to corporate card - attach agent receipt/statement.
```
That helps audit. For parking cash with no receipt, attach photo of the location, time, and short explanation. We try to avoid cash gaps but will approve small ones with manager note.

julia: sample note for the swag line?

liz (People Ops): Paste this into the expense notes:
```
Event: SF workshops 2026-06-22
Expense: Promo shirts - 45 units @ $12 each - total $540. Ordered by Julia per Events PO #EV-421 (PO attached). Distribution: attendee swag. Requesting reimbursement to personal card.
```

josh (Finance): SIM card: attach the e-receipt or card photo + itemized charge. Reimburse converted to USD at posted rate. Card fees for activating SIMs are reimbursable; ongoing personal data charges are not.

julia: parking ticket  i have a photo of the pay station and time stamped phone photo. will that do?

josh (Finance): Yes for <$25 that's fine. Upload the photo, add bank/cc line if you paid by card, or a short affidavit for cash. Manager sign-off speeds approval.

liz (People Ops): One more note: group purchases like swag should indicate budget owner (Events or Marketing). If not pre-approved, the expense may be routed for approval and delayed. For high-ticket promo items > $1k get written approval ahead of purchase.

people-ops-bot: Travel & expense policy: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-policy See sections: "Vendor invoice splits", "Conference swag and promo budgets", "Lost parking receipts", "Local SIMs", "Rental-car insurance".

julia: perfect, i'll split the invoice, attach PO, and submit. thanks all :thumbsup:
